content:
alex: seeing intermittent missing req ids from node sampleapp in staging during warmup. small snippet:
```
INFO server=sampleapp msg=starting
INFO route=/health msg=ok
INFO tokens=0 msg=done
```
no req_id field (used to be req_id=...).

maria: only during startup? or across runtime?

alex: mostly startup/cold boot. go/python sampleapps still show req_id.

pat: that screams init ordering. node SDK recently auto-inits OTEL and our reqid hook depends on context from spans. if sampler drops the span the ctx never gets reqid before the logger runs.

juno: i reproduced locally with OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.0 and LOG_LEVEL=info. ~15% of requests during first 30s had no req_id. adding a tiny sleep in middleware made it disappear, so timing race.

telemetry-bot: note: redactor update pushed last week changed the masking regex for tokens. there were a few followups about truncated ids.

maria: truncated how?

alex: example in debug logs: req=4f3c2a__ (underscores where it was redacted). looks like the redactor matched parts of our compact ids when logs chunk.

pat: current redactor regex is permissive. propose switching to strict hyphenated uuid pattern + allowlist for traceparent header. also make reqid attach not depend on OTEL span: attach from raw headers first, then backfill from context if present.

juno: i can open a small node PR to reorder the logging hooks so reqid attach is the first hook and add a unit test that asserts every bootstrap line contains req_id. will also add an e2e that runs node+go with sampler=[0.0,1.0].

maria: add a migration note for the redactor change (some enterprise users relied on old mask behavior). and set REDWOOD_REQID_FALLBACK=true in staging as a short-term mitigation so logger synthesizes an id when missing.

ops-bot: REDWOOD_REQID_FALLBACK=true applied to staging cluster cluster-stg-7 by ops at 2026-03-27T09:10:00Z

alex: thanks. action items: juno open PR for hook reorder + test, pat tighten redactor regex + doc note, ci add sampler parity matrix (node,go). i'll monitor staging post-canary.

maria: tl;dr: race between otel sampler and reqid attach caused intermittent loss; redactor made truncated ids worse. reorder + header-first attach + safer regex = fix. :thumbsup:
